locator.title: 7 фишек «Острова Мечты», которые сделают ваш отдых ярче
locator.lead: 7 секретов «Острова Мечты»: где искать крутые фото и экстремальные развлечения
locator.caption: Устройте батл с друзьями или семьей и выясните, кто в компании самый меткий. А еще не забудьте запомнить свой счет: сюда стоит вернуться хотя бы для того, чтобы побить собственный рекорд

current_heading.text: Фишка 3. Три развлечения в одном на «Башне Гаргамеля»

nearest_text_before.text: Можно стрелять без остановки и надеяться на победу, а можно тщательно метиться в каждую мишень и не тратить ни одного выстрела впустую. Какой подход принесет больше очков — узнаете в финале.

nearest_text_after.text: Фишка 4. Приключение, спрятанное в скалах, — «Пещеры Острова»*

image_reading: A group of children and young women sit secured in bright yellow ride seats inside a themed indoor attraction.
The seat assembly and its central mechanism are fully visible; several riders are smiling or waving toward the camera.
The frontal composition can support a gentle, coordinated movement of the ride without introducing unseen game elements.
analysis.article_context: This gallery image supports the section about Gargamel’s Tower as a shared family challenge: riders experience the attraction together while competing for the best result.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A shared ride becomes an exciting group challenge for friends and family.
structured_intent.primary_action: The occupied ride seat assembly rises together.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The visible row of riders is clearly elevated above its starting position as the ascent eases.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The group remains securely seated and cheerfully engaged in the shared attraction experience.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the visible row of seats starts lifting as one continuous ride motion. Keep the frontal camera fixed on the riders and central mechanism; let the riders show restrained, natural reactions while remaining securely seated. The lift continues nearly to the end, finishing with the row clearly higher in frame and still gently rising.
models.positive_prompt: The ride seat assembly begins a smooth, moderate upward lift; the riders stay seated with cheerful anticipation and make only subtle natural body reactions. Fixed frontal camera. In the final frames, the whole row is visibly raised and still ascending gently.

models.scene_plan: Use the full five seconds for one smooth ascent of the ride seats. The fixed front-facing view keeps the group and mechanism readable while their restrained reactions develop with the lift. The motion eases naturally near the end, leaving the riders visibly elevated and still excited.
models.positive_prompt: The seated ride group rises together in a steady, moderate lift, with small excited posture shifts and sustained smiles. Fixed front view of the riders. End with the seats visibly elevated as the upward motion eases.

models.scene_plan: In four seconds, show a focused start of the attraction: the entire visible seat row ascends in one continuous, moderate movement. Hold a fixed frontal composition on the group, using only small natural reactions from the riders. End as the ascent slows with the row unmistakably elevated.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed frontal view: the ride seats lift together at a smooth moderate pace; the riders remain securely seated, smiling, with subtle excited body movement. The final frame shows the row clearly raised as the lift slows.
